sentences.en: You look at the five states with the highest percentages of public land
sentences.zh: 看看公共土地比例最高的五个州

sentences.en: That's Alaska, Nevada, Utah, Idaho, Wyoming
sentences.zh: 它们是阿拉斯加、内华达、犹他、爱达荷、怀俄明

sentences.en: All this land is in states where there aren't that many people
sentences.zh: 所有这些土地都在人口并不多的州

sentences.en: Ilgunas believes a right to roam system could help connect all these disparate pieces of public land
sentences.zh: 埃尔古纳斯相信，自由漫步制度可以帮助连接所有这些零散的公共土地

sentences.en: And give us a sense of ownership
sentences.zh: 并赋予我们一种主人翁意识

sentences.en: I think if we bring in a system like the right to roam
sentences.zh: 我想如果我们引入像自由漫步这样的制度

sentences.en: You know, we're still going to look at the land as if it's someone's
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们依然会把土地看作是属于某人的

sentences.en: But I think we'll also begin to look at it as if it's sort of ours
sentences.zh: 但我想我们也会开始把它看作是某种程度上属于我们的

sentences.en: And for what it's worth, my dad agrees
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，我爸爸表示赞同

sentences.en: He says there's something really special about being able to walk wherever you want
sentences.zh: 他说能够随心所欲地走到任何你想去的地方，这种感觉真的非常特别

sentences.en: I thought the whole concept of being able to walk respectfully across private land was extraordinary
sentences.zh: 我觉得能够满怀尊重地穿过私有土地这一整个概念非同寻常

sentences.en: And it was something that just doesn't exist here
sentences.zh: 而且这是这里根本不存在的东西

sentences.en: We have a lot of public land where you can walk in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们有很多可以步行的公共土地

sentences.en: But this seemed very different
sentences.zh: 但这个感觉非常不同

sentences.en: There were so many routes and trails to choose from
sentences.zh: 有那么多的路线和步道可供选择

sentences.en: It felt like the whole country was open to you
sentences.zh: 感觉整个国家向你敞开

sentences.en: These days, if you ramble across the open grasslands of England or Wales
sentences.zh: 如今，如果你在英格兰或威尔士开阔的草地上漫步

sentences.en: You'll see the remnants of enclosure
sentences.zh: 你会看到土地被围起来的痕迹

sentences.en: The stone walls and fences
sentences.zh: 石墙和篱笆

sentences.en: And you'll also see the things meant to help you get past these barriers
sentences.zh: 你还会看到旨在帮你越过这些障碍的设施

sentences.en: The stiles, which are step-ladders to help you get over fences
sentences.zh: 登对梯，也就是帮你翻越篱笆的阶梯

sentences.en: The so-called kissing gates
sentences.zh: 所谓的亲吻门

sentences.en: Which are V-shaped openings that people can walk through but livestock cannot
sentences.zh: 那是V形的开口，人可以通过，但牲畜过不去

sentences.en: Because the fences aren't there to stop you anymore
sentences.zh: 因为篱笆不再是为了阻拦你

sentences.en: You just hop over and continue on your way
sentences.zh: 你只要跨过去就可以继续前行

sentences.en: Some places go beyond a right to roam and offer free shelter to a weary rambler
sentences.zh: 有些地方不仅有自由漫步权，还为疲惫的漫游者提供免费庇护所

sentences.en: We visit Bothy's up next
sentences.zh: 接下来我们将参观石屋

sentences.en: After England and Wales began implementing their Countryside and Rights of Way Act
sentences.zh: 在英格兰和威尔士开始实施《乡村与通行权法案》之后

sentences.en: Scotland, I love Scotland, they decided to take things a step further
sentences.zh: 苏格兰，我爱苏格兰，他们决定更进一步

sentences.en: So in 2003, they passed their own Land Reform Act
sentences.zh: 所以在2003年，他们通过了自己的《土地改革法》

sentences.en: And it did a bunch of things
sentences.zh: 它发挥了诸多作用

sentences.en: But first and foremost, it codified a long tradition of public access
sentences.zh: 但首先也是最重要的是，它以法律形式确立了公众通行的悠久传统

sentences.en: Basically, if people are respectful of other people and property
sentences.zh: 基本上，如果人们尊重他人和财产

sentences.en: They can roam even more freely on private land up north
sentences.zh: 他们就能在北方的私有土地上更自由地漫步

sentences.en: And it's part of a larger ethos about accessibility
sentences.zh: 这是关于无障碍理念的更广泛精神的一部分

sentences.en: Exemplified by these little buildings called Bothy's
sentences.zh: 这些被称为石屋的小建筑物就是例证

sentences.en: A regional phenomenon that Kurt Kolstad is here to tell us about
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯特德将在这里向我们介绍这一区域现象

sentences.en: So historically, a Bothy was typically a small cottage for farm workers
sentences.zh: 所以从历史上看，石屋通常是农场工人的一个小村舍

sentences.en: But rural depopulation led to a lot of these being abandoned
sentences.zh: 但农村人口外流导致其中许多被废弃

sentences.en: So travelers who saw they were empty started spending the nights in them
sentences.zh: 于是发现它们空着的旅行者开始在里面过夜

sentences.en: So the first time I ever encountered the word Bothy
sentences.zh: 所以我第一次遇到“石屋”这个词

sentences.en: Was in Starling, Scotland
sentences.zh: 是在苏格兰的斯特灵

sentences.en: And I ate at a place for lunch called the Coffee Bothy
sentences.zh: 我在一个叫“咖啡石屋”的地方吃午饭

sentences.en: Which I think is not these sort of things
sentences.zh: 我想这并不是指这种石屋

sentences.en: But it's kind of like us saying that I ate at a Pizza Hut last night
sentences.zh: 但这就像我们说昨晚我去必胜客吃的一样

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly, right
sentences.zh: 对，没错

sentences.en: So Bothy like has this broader association of these old, you know
sentences.zh: 所以石屋这种叫法带有一种更广泛的联想，你知道的

sentences.en: Old small buildings on farmsteads
sentences.zh: 农庄里的旧小建筑物

sentences.en: But yeah, now it's sort of grown to have this larger meaning
sentences.zh: 但是的，现在它已经演变出了更广泛的含义

sentences.en: Of also being these places to stay
sentences.zh: 也就是可以住宿的地方

sentences.en: So if you bump into a traveler and say
sentences.zh: 所以如果你偶遇一个旅行者并说

sentences.en: Hey, I'm staying at the Bothy
sentences.zh: 嘿，我住在石屋里

sentences.en: They'll probably know what you mean
sentences.zh: 他们大概会明白你的意思

sentences.en: Right, right, cool
sentences.zh: 对，对，太酷了

sentences.en: So Bothy's can be found across the British Isles
sentences.zh: 所以不列颠群岛到处都能找到石屋

sentences.en: But especially in the Scottish Highlands
sentences.zh: 但尤其以苏格兰高地为多

sentences.en: And while they're publicly accessible
sentences.zh: 虽然它们对公众开放

sentences.en: Most are still on private property
sentences.zh: 但大多数仍在私有土地上

sentences.en: And the owners just let Ramblers sleep on their land
sentences.zh: 业主只是允许漫游者在他们的土地上睡觉

sentences.en: In Bothys that they own
sentences.zh: 在他们拥有的石屋里

sentences.en: They do
sentences.zh: 确实如此

sentences.en: Over time, a lot of these landowners
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，许多这样的土地所有者

sentences.en: Have actually really embraced the tradition
sentences.zh: 实际上已经真正接受了这一传统

sentences.en: Leaving buildings unlocked and open for use
sentences.zh: 让建筑物保持不锁状态，供人使用

sentences.en: But it's a community effort too
sentences.zh: 但这也是社区共同努力的结果

sentences.en: There are volunteers who help take care of and manage Bothys
sentences.zh: 有志愿者通过山地石屋协会

sentences.en: Through the Mountain Bothy Association
sentences.zh: 来帮助照看和管理石屋

sentences.en: Which is a Scottish charity
sentences.zh: 这是一个苏格兰慈善机构

sentences.en: So I'm picturing these mostly as like small, dark stone cottages
sentences.zh: 所以我脑海中的这些大多是小型、阴暗的石头村舍

sentences.en: Angled roofs, little chimneys
sentences.zh: 倾斜的屋顶，小烟囱

sentences.en: On rolling, grassy hillsides
sentences.zh: 坐落在连绵起伏的草地山坡上

sentences.en: That's the image I'm going to complete
sentences.zh: 这就是我要完成的画面

sentences.en: Is that about right?
sentences.zh: 差不多是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so a lot of them look exactly like what you're imagining
sentences.zh: 对，所以其中很多看起来和你想象的完全一样

sentences.en: But not all of them
sentences.zh: 但并非全部如此

sentences.en: There's actually a pretty wide variety
sentences.zh: 实际上它们在环境和建筑风格上

sentences.en: In terms of their settings and their architecture
sentences.zh: 有着相当大的差异

sentences.en: Some are inland, others along the beaches
sentences.zh: 有些在内陆，有些在海滩边

sentences.en: Some used to be things like post offices or schools
sentences.zh: 有些过去曾是邮局或学校之类的建筑

sentences.en: And there's this one out in the coastal cliffs of Skye
sentences.zh: 斯凯岛的海岸悬崖上还有这样一个地方

sentences.en: Called The Lookout
sentences.zh: 叫做“瞭望台”

sentences.en: That was actually built to be a Coast Guard station
sentences.zh: 它原本是作为海岸警卫队站建造的

sentences.en: And it has these big windows
sentences.zh: 它有这样的大窗户

sentences.en: And these really awesome panoramic views
sentences.zh: 还有令人惊叹的全景视野

sentences.en: And it comes with binoculars, wildlife identification charts
sentences.zh: 里面还配有双筒望远镜、野生动物识别图表

sentences.en: And this logbook for people who want to watch the dolphins and the whales
sentences.zh: 以及供想要观看海豚和鲸鱼的人使用的航海日志

sentences.en: So there's no reservations
sentences.zh: 所以不需要预订

sentences.en: You just ramble up and you can stay in one of these places
sentences.zh: 你只需要漫步走过去，就能在这些地方住下

sentences.en: That's the idea
sentences.zh: 就是这个意思

sentences.en: Though you have to find them first
sentences.zh: 不过你得先找到它们

sentences.en: And that wasn't always easy to do
sentences.zh: 而这并不总是那么容易做到

sentences.en: For decades it was mainly a word of mouth system
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这主要靠口碑相传

sentences.en: And then a few years back
sentences.zh: 直到几年前

sentences.en: The Mountain Bothy Association started putting maps up online
sentences.zh: 山地石屋协会开始把地图放到网上

sentences.en: Making it easier for people to plan out their trips and get to them
sentences.zh: 让人们更容易规划行程并到达那里

sentences.en: So you get nature, you get views, they're free
sentences.zh: 所以你能亲近自然、欣赏美景，而且还是免费的

sentences.en: Where do you sign up?
sentences.zh: 哪里可以报名？

sentences.en: I mean that's pretty stunning
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真的很惊艳

sentences.en: Well you don't have to sign up
sentences.zh: 好吧，你不用非得注册

sentences.en: Which is the beauty of it
sentences.zh: 这就是它的魅力所在

sentences.en: But I should warn you
sentences.zh: 不过我得提醒你

sentences.en: That bodies can be pretty minimalist at times
sentences.zh: 那些石屋有时非常简陋

sentences.en: Some have sleeping platforms
sentences.zh: 有些带有简易床铺

sentences.en: And stoves and little libraries
sentences.zh: 还有炉灶和小书架

sentences.en: Things like that
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的东西

sentences.en: But they don't typically have running water
sentences.zh: 但它们通常没有自来水

sentences.en: Or much insulation
sentences.zh: 也没什么保温层

sentences.en: Still, I mean it is a really impressive system
sentences.zh: 不过说实话，这确实是一个令人印象深刻的系统

sentences.en: And a great way to repurpose old buildings
sentences.zh: 而且这也是重新利用旧建筑的好方法

sentences.en: That are not otherwise in use
sentences.zh: 那些原本闲置的建筑

sentences.en: And it works especially well in Scotland
sentences.zh: 而且在苏格兰效果尤为显著

sentences.en: Where really remote places can be accessed in part
sentences.zh: 在那些极其偏远的地方，部分原因可以归结为

sentences.en: Thanks to really permissive roaming laws
sentences.zh: 多亏了非常宽容的漫游法

sentences.en: How do I know I'm staying in a designated Bothy on someone's land
sentences.zh: 我怎么知道自己住的是别人土地上指定的山林小屋

sentences.en: Rather than just accidentally sleeping in their garden shed?
sentences.zh: 而不是不小心睡在了人家的花园杂物棚里呢？

sentences.en: You know, I'm not sure
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我也不太确定

sentences.en: I didn't see anything about this when I was reading about them
sentences.zh: 我阅读有关它们的信息时，没看到这方面的说法

sentences.en: But I wonder like, you know
sentences.zh: 但我在想，你知道的

sentences.en: If you did just accidentally stay in an abandoned building
sentences.zh: 如果你真的只是不小心住进了一栋废弃的建筑

sentences.en: I mean that's how Bothy started, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，山林小屋一开始就是这样来的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like that was sort of the origin of it
sentences.zh: 就像那是它的起源一样

sentences.en: Is this a system that's unique to Scotland?
sentences.zh: 这是一个苏格兰独有的系统吗？

sentences.en: Not entirely
sentences.zh: 不完全是

sentences.en: The US and Canada, Australia, New Zealand
sentences.zh: 美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、新西兰

sentences.en: And actually a lot of Northern European countries
sentences.zh: 事实上，许多北欧国家

sentences.en: Also have their own versions
sentences.zh: 也有它们自己的版本

sentences.en: That said, in many places they're even more rustic
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，在许多地方，它们甚至更加简陋

sentences.en: And they're often owned and operated by government agencies
sentences.zh: 而且通常由政府机构拥有和运营

sentences.en: And set up on public lands
sentences.zh: 并设立在公共土地上

sentences.en: Right, and we have a much more divided system here
sentences.zh: 没错，我们这里有一个划分得更明确的系统

sentences.en: Of public versus private land
sentences.zh: 即公共土地与私人土地之分

sentences.en: When it comes to private property
sentences.zh: 说到私有财产

sentences.en: You really have to watch out for those no trespassing signs
sentences.zh: 你真的得小心那些“严禁入内”的标志

sentences.en: And heed their warning
sentences.zh: 并听从它们的警告

sentences.en: Exactly
sentences.zh: 完全正确

sentences.en: While in Scotland, people really can just go out and wander
sentences.zh: 而在苏格兰，人们真的可以随意出去漫游

sentences.en: In the truest sense of the word
sentences.zh: 在这个词最真实的意义上

sentences.en: And if they happen to come across a Bothy
sentences.zh: 如果他们恰巧碰到了一个山林小屋

sentences.en: Along the way, they can just walk right in
sentences.zh: 一路上，他们可以直接走进去

sentences.en: And listeners can find images of Bothys
sentences.zh: 听众们可以找到山林小屋的图片

sentences.en: As well as links to maps
sentences.zh: 以及地图的链接

sentences.en: And other information about the Bothy Network
sentences.zh: 还有关于山林小屋网络的其他信息

sentences.en: In an article that Kurt just published on our website
sentences.zh: 在库尔特刚刚在我们网站上发表的一篇文章中

sentences.en: It's at 99pi.org
sentences.zh: 网址是 99pi.org
